# laravelforge_site_deploy_hook (Resource)

Manages the deployment-trigger (deploy-hook) URL for a Laravel Forge site. Singleton per site; applying it (re)generates the hook token.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose deploy hook is managed.

### Read-Only

- `url` (String) The deployment-trigger URL for the site.
